subject: error with geom_tiplab() with latest ggtree while looping over trees

messages.author: 03d6e87fd598d518
messages.subject: error with geom_tiplab() with latest ggtree while looping over trees
parts:
Hi,

I do not know when this problem began, nor do I exactly know what version  this is an issue with, though I lay out my thoughts below, as it may be related to the latest version.

Issue: geom_tiplab() function is producing cryptic errors with ggtree_3.1.2 or 
I have ggtree_2.4.1 installed on another computer and this error is not encountered.

Example.
## producing 4 random trees
trees <- lapply(c(10, 25, 50, 100), rtree) 
## creating tree object of 4 trees with lapply without the use of geom_tiplab() works fine
lapply(trees, function(x) {ggtree(x)})
## creating tree object while including geom_tiplab() fails
 lapply(trees, function(x) {ggtree(x) + geom_tiplab()}) 
## Error: 
Error in match.call(call = sys.call(sys.parent(1))) :
  ... used in a situation where it does not exist
## Note, this error does not occur with a ggtree version ggtree_2.4.1

## Finally, when running each tree individually, no error occurs with geom_tiplab()
## Such as:

ggtree(trees[[1]]) + geom_tiplab()

## Or when using facet_wrap for trees,  geom_tiplab() works fine
trees.mp <- trees
class(trees.mp) <- "multiPhylo"
ggtree(trees.mp) + geom_tiplab() + facet_wrap(~.id, scale="free", nrow=1)

## Please help, as being able to create a looped tree object with geom_tiplab() is important for my plotting needs.
## However, I hope that I am just missing something, but unfortunately have not been able to figure this out.

## I also tried with a much earlier version of ggtree, v1.14.6 and the looking with geom_tiplab() works fine
## So this seems to be an issue with the latest ggttree version_3.1.0 and/or version_3.1.2

Thanks,

Bob

I'll post an solution to my own message.
Found someone else's post on a github link here that was similar
https://github.com/YuLab-SMU/ggtree/issues/404

Solution was to install github version of ggtree, which worked for me as well.
